description: Got a notification from e-bird that a female smew was in my county.  I found it exactly where they said it was, with other birders there.  It has a brownish head, dark back, white throat and cheeks.  Was hanging out with a group of mallards, mostly trailing further back from the main group.  It is much smaller. Different profile to head.  Located on Lake Allegan on the Kalamazoo River.
in flock of approx 40 Com Merganser, actively feeding, continuing observation for several days, one photographer/ebirder states it has bands, possibly first ever reported for MI
